genre.description: which genre kit runs (game rules); every system stays available

player.description: gsys: the Stark World Engine Systems player plays this world; legacy: the studio engine

languages.description: languages the game text uses (sharpens the child-safety checker)

characters.description: cast: every character has an age group (default adult)

age.description: child | teen | adult or a number of years (default adult)

schedule.description: schedule id or a list of entries

romanceable.description: adults only - the child-safety rules block it for minors

items.description: {kind, x, z, name, ...}: things the studio object list has no type for (campfire, vehicle, exit, building, shrine, animal, board, station, resource nodes)

quests.description: quests in addition to the studio quests

additionalProperties.description: studio dialog format + vars / rep / affinity conditions and actions

day_length.description: seconds per in-game day (0 = time stands still)

safety.description: informational stamp written by the export gate; never read to relax any rule

title: Stark World Engine Systems world.json "systems" extension (version 1)
